title: Bob the Drag Queen wins Season 8
summary: In the Grand Finale (US-S08-E10), Bob the Drag Queen was crowned America's Next Drag Superstar over runners-up Kim Chi and Naomi Smalls. The Season 8 cash prize was $100,000.

title: Bob's Snatch Game as Crazy Eyes and Carol Channing
summary: On Supermodel Snatch Game (US-S08-E05), Bob the Drag Queen won the maxi challenge with a dual impression of Crazy Eyes (Orange Is the New Black) and Carol Channing — an early showcase of the comedy that carried Bob to the crown.

title: Season 8's early double elimination
summary: In Bitch Perfect (US-S08-E02), Dax ExclamationPoint and Laila McQueen were both eliminated after lip-syncing to Gloria Gaynor's "I Will Survive" — a double sashay that trimmed the cast early.
